signed_rows.behavior: kmaudit, built as a wheel from packages/kmaudit and installed into a fresh virtual environment that does not have kmctl, runs `kmaudit claims todo --json` on a fixture OKF bundle in a git repository and prints its sections.
signed_rows.fails_when: the wheel does not build, kmctl gets installed alongside it, the command exits nonzero, or it prints no section of the fixture bundle

signed_rows.behavior: No Python module under packages/kmaudit imports kmctl, and kmaudit's pyproject.toml does not depend on kmctl.
signed_rows.fails_when: any module under packages/kmaudit/src or packages/kmaudit/tests has an import of kmctl, or kmaudit's dependencies name kmctl

signed_rows.behavior: One `uv run pytest` at the repository root collects and runs both kmctl's tests under tests/ and kmaudit's under packages/kmaudit/tests.
signed_rows.fails_when: the root run collects no test from packages/kmaudit/tests or none from tests/, or collection errors
signed_rows.command: uv run pytest --collect-only -q | grep -q '^packages/kmaudit/tests/' && uv run pytest --collect-only -q | grep -q '^tests/'

signed_rows.behavior: kmctl has no audit group and no audit extra: `kmctl audit --help` fails as an unknown command and kmctl's package metadata lists no audit extra.
signed_rows.fails_when: `kmctl audit` still resolves to a command group, or kmctl's metadata Provides-Extra includes audit

signed_rows.behavior: Every audit behaviour tested before the move is still tested after it: the audit tests that lived under tests/ run under packages/kmaudit/tests against kmaudit and pass.
signed_rows.fails_when: an audit test from tests/ was deleted rather than moved (other than the CLI name changing from kmctl audit to kmaudit), or the moved tests fail

signed_rows.behavior: Outside .loop/, .okf/log.md, .okf/prototypes/ and decision records superseded by the new one, no tracked file says `kmctl audit` or `kmctl[audit]`; the root README names the two packages and links packages/kmaudit/README.md.
signed_rows.fails_when: git grep finds `kmctl audit` or `kmctl[audit]` in a file outside those exclusions, or README.md does not link packages/kmaudit/README.md

signed_rows.behavior: A new decision record says the audit left kmctl to become kmaudit, a separate package in this monorepo served over MCP, names the alternative it rejected (keeping kmctl audit, or moving kmctl into packages/ too), and marks the records it supersedes; the OKF bundle validates strictly.
signed_rows.fails_when: no such record exists, it names no rejected alternative, or okf validate --strict fails
